wiki.title: David Gowan
wiki.extract: David M. Gowan Sr. is an American politician currently serving as a member of the Arizona Senate from the 19th district since 2023, having previously represented the 14th district from 2019 to 2023. A member of the Republican Party, Gowan served in the Arizona House of Representatives from 2009 to 2017, serving as the House's speaker from 2015 to 2017.
